project.title: BAKEBOX-AI: AUTONOMOUS AI Bakery Management AND CUSTOMER SUPPORT
project.short_description: 24/7 Autonomous AI Customer Care, Order Tracking & Master Baker Digital Management Platform for Shri Ram Baker (Mathura) powered by IBM Db2 native vector search (DB2LlamaVS), LlamaIndex Hybrid RRF, and live transactional order intelligence.

members.name: Ayush Dhangar
members.role: Full-Stack Architect, IBM Db2 & AI Systems Engineer

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker / VS Code IBM Db2 Extension Instance - IBMDB201)
features_used: Native VECTOR Column (VECTOR(384, FLOAT32)) with in-engine Cosine distance search
In-engine Cosine Vector Search via official DB2LlamaVS LlamaIndex vector store
Relational Transactional Tables (BB_ORDERS, BB_ORDER_ITEMS) for real-time kitchen baking status
Enterprise Inventory Catalogs (BB_CAKES, BB_CUSTOM_CAKES, BB_PARTY_ACCESSORIES for 610+ items)
Hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF: k=60) combining Db2 dense vectors with TF-IDF lexical search
Zero-External Vector DB: 100% embeddings, relational records, and conversational memory in IBM Db2
